home.lead: Four years of production frontend. React, Vue, TypeScript — and every number on this page is a demo you can run.
home.manifestoTitle: NDA hides the code, not the engineering
home.manifesto: Most of what I have built is under NDA and cannot be linked. So instead of screenshots, the feature itself is rebuilt here — runnable, in the browser, with the numbers on screen.
home.manifestoNote: Client code stays closed. The engineering decision does not: an undo buffer, a frame budget, a virtualised table — all of it can be reconstructed from scratch and shipped as something you can click.
